annotations.title: Get the state of a car watch

description: Use this to check whether an intent created with intent_publish_intent is already confirmed by the user and active, waiting, expired or withdrawn. Requires the intentCode; returns the statement and dates only — never the user's e-mail, the hidden limit or any other personal data.
name: intent_get_intent

status.description: awaiting_consent = the user has not confirmed on the AutoIsto page yet; awaiting_email_confirmation = the user filled in the page and must click the link in the e-mail; active = AutoIsto is watching; expired = the confirmation link, the buy-by date or the intent's validity ran out; withdrawn = cancelled.

validUntil.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) until which the intent is watched (before confirmation: until the draft is deleted).

title: Get the state of a car watch
